freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 限时开放 100,000,000 tokens 免费总额度。Atria Dawn Preview 由上海人工智能实验室与多所高校联合开源，面向科研工作者、开发者与专业知识工作者：给定一个研究问题、一段代码或一份数据，它能自主检索资料、调用工具并运行测试，直接产出可核查的研究报告、跑通的程序、可编辑的文档表格，甚至 3D 机械零件模型和可玩的小游戏。兼容 Chat Completions / Messages / Responses 三种接口。
freeTierSummary.en: Limited-time 100M free tokens. Atria Dawn Preview from Shanghai AI Laboratory and partner universities is an agent model for researchers, developers, and knowledge workers: it searches sources, calls tools, and runs tests to deliver verifiable reports, working programs, editable documents, even 3D parts and mini-games.
